answer: The crystal schedule is applied in jetty and velvet makes public each instalment. An copycat therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1393 identities would post 4102 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
